# opentype.js 2.0.0

Unmodified `dist/opentype.mjs` and MIT `LICENSE` from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/opentype.js/-/opentype.js-2.0.0.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/opentypejs/opentype.js

Package SHA-512 (base64):
`kCyjv6xdDY1W/jLWZ/L3QhhTlKUqDZMQ5+Jdlw12b3dXkKNpYBqqlMMj0YDQPShWFTMwgZI1hG14kN3XUDSg/A==`

Bundled locally for the static site and loaded lazily by the TTF importer. No
runtime CDN, installation, or build step is required. To update, download a pinned
official npm release, verify its registry integrity, replace the module and
license, update the import path, and run the TTF and browser regressions.
